title: Nuggets hold off Pacers in NBA Mexico City game
summary: Denver star Nikola Jokic scored 19 points and grabbed 13 rebounds as the Nuggets held off Indiana's second-half surge to triumph 114-102 on Saturday in the NBA's Mexico City game.
